presentation.label: Two more MIDI CC controls
presentation.summary: Two extra CC controls, numeric headers, saved track names, and explicit Bank A setup for all banks.
presentation.overview: Midi Mode 2 adds two CC controls per MIDI track and numeric headers. F at NAME/PUSH opens the stock ten-character editor. Set Bank A / Part 1 names and channels, save normally, then hold FUNC and push D at INIT. The first setup preserves legacy overrides. To replace an existing setup, choose YES at REPLACE ALL; it copies Bank A names and channels to every bank and Part, including empty names and OFF channels. NO cancels. Progress shows the bank; NO also cancels safely during work. Ordinary bank changes and restart never reapply defaults. Save to New carries names and the saved marker.
highlights: Two additional CC positions per MIDI track when PB and AT are both mapped.
Independent CC0–127 assignments for the A and B positions.
Numeric CC headers on both MIDI CONTROL pages.
Restore pitch bend or aftertouch with a click in SETUP.
Initialize from Bank A, keep independent bank edits, or explicitly confirm INIT again to replace all names and channels. Save to New carries the saved profile.
usage: Select a MIDI track and double-tap FX1 to open MIDI CONTROL 1 SETUP.
Click A or B to switch its PB or AT position into CC mode. Turn to choose CC0–127, then press YES.
Press FX1 to return. Enable the value with FUNC + encoder press and turn it to send values on the track’s output channel.
Click again in SETUP to restore native behavior. Entering CC mode starts at CC0.
Double-tap SRC on a MIDI track, click F (NAME/PUSH), enter up to ten characters and confirm with YES or cancel with NO.
Back up a disposable project. Set Bank A / Part 1 names and channels, stop transport and recorders, and save the project normally.
After Save to New, open PROJECT → SAVE PROJECT separately and let it finish before INIT; this creates the new project’s stored bank copies.
Try the updated MIDI controls and Keep installed before starting INIT, so restart can recover an unfinished setup using this version.

In MIDI SRC SETUP, hold FUNC and push D at INIT (FN+ / PUSH). On a previously initialized project, REPLACE ALL? YES/NO asks before replacing all bank names and channels with Bank A / Part 1. YES confirms; NO cancels. Wait for MIDI SETUP SAVED.

After INIT, name or channel edits stay in their own banks. Save channels normally; wait for MIDI PROFILE SAVED after names. Repeating INIT requires explicit YES to overwrite them; bank changes and restart never do that. Save to New carries names and the marker.

controls.name: A mode
controls.doc: Click encoder A in CONTROL 1 SETUP to switch pitch bend to CC. Entering CC mode starts at CC0.

controls.name: B mode
controls.doc: Click encoder B in CONTROL 1 SETUP to switch aftertouch to CC, independently of A.

controls.name: CC assignment
controls.doc: In CC mode, turn the corresponding SETUP encoder to select CC0–127 and confirm with YES.

controls.name: A value
controls.doc: On CONTROL 1, enable the value with FUNC + encoder press, then turn its encoder to send 0–127. The displayed assignment is separate from the value. A retains the current pitch-bend position’s value; a fresh project starts at 64.

controls.name: B value
controls.doc: On CONTROL 1, enable the value with FUNC + encoder press, then turn its encoder to send 0–127. The displayed assignment is separate from the value. B retains the current aftertouch position’s value; a fresh project starts at 0.

controls.name: Track name
controls.doc: Click F in MIDI NOTE SETUP. Ten characters; YES confirms, NO cancels. Names autosave while stopped and are shared by Parts within each bank. Before INIT, unedited banks inherit Bank A; INIT freezes independent snapshots.

controls.name: Apply project setup
controls.doc: Save the project first. Hold FUNC and click D at INIT. A saved setup asks REPLACE ALL? YES/NO: YES replaces every bank’s names and all current/saved Part channels with Bank A / Part 1, including blanks/OFF. NO cancels before replacement or safely during progress. Plain D only shows the gesture hint.

access.location: MIDI track → double-tap FX1 → MIDI CONTROL 1 SETUP. A and B switch PB/AT to CC.
steps: Select a MIDI track and set its output channel for your receiving instrument.
Double-tap FX1 to open CONTROL 1 SETUP. Click A or B to switch its mode to CC.
Turn the corresponding encoder to choose CC0–127, then press YES.
Press FX1 to return to CONTROL 1. Enable its value with FUNC + encoder press, then turn it.
Press FX2 for CONTROL 2; both pages show assigned controller numbers.
Return to CONTROL 1 SETUP and click a mapped encoder again to restore its native PB or AT function.

Keep the updated module installed before INIT. After Save to New, also complete PROJECT → SAVE PROJECT. Save normally, hold FUNC and click D, then confirm YES to replace all banks from Bank A / Part 1. NO cancels. Wait for MIDI SETUP SAVED; report a CHECK FAILED or APPLY FAILED code if shown.

limitations: Local experimental USB draft. Requires loader ABI 8, at least 24 sites and 25 stock copies; public shared lifecycle events and hardware qualification remain pending.

Back up and save normally before INIT. Working and stored bank copies may have different channels, but both must have valid checksums and matching non-channel data. The working map must match the native project. Recovery records and restores each disk map separately.
Names and marker use MIDI4_0.DAT / MIDI4_1.DAT; recovery uses MIDI4_J0.DAT / MIDI4_J1.DAT. Keep all sidecars with backups. Existing MIDI3_*.DAT and MIDI2_*.DAT import read-only and remain unchanged.

Apply changes native bank files once; Undo/removal does not reverse completed project edits. Progress yields between bank pairs. NO cancels at a safe boundary; live failure rolls back in place without automatic reload. Boot recovery may reload after restoring files. Loss of both verified peers requires backup recovery.
Bank changes and restart never remap defaults. Names remain shared across Parts in a bank. Only explicitly repeating INIT and confirming YES replaces saved bank overrides.

Keep 0.0.13 installed before INIT so startup uses the version that understands an unfinished setup. Older versions refuse the new pending journal. Completed or cancelled transactions leave a terminal record older versions can read. No independently bound physical 0.0.13 result or timing qualification is claimed.
Switching back into CC mode starts at CC0 rather than recalling its previous number.

storage.label: Runtime package
storage.conditions: Package bytes and image size measured from the verified relocatable package. Runtime loader metadata and copied stock spans add allocation overhead.

processing.label: ColdFire control processing
processing.conditions: Emulator and source checks do not measure physical CPU load or timing headroom.

impact.conditions: Source estimates for a small MIDI/UI adapter; no physical worst-case timing or load measurement.

cpu.rationale: Apply and rollback yield between bank pairs. Bank CRC verification uses one table lookup per byte instead of two; all original file checks remain. Bare page browsing and NO are allowed. Physical elapsed time and chip load remain unmeasured.

dsp.rationale: No authored DSP program or DSP effect slot is added.

memory.rationale: The 28,964-byte image occupies a calculated 31,216-byte loader pool extent on the current base; same-size replacement plus Undo retains 62,432 bytes. Compiler frames are recorded; complete stack and whole-system peaks remain unbounded. Four 4,096-byte project sidecars are card storage.

tests.summary: Cooper reported that the current local 0.0.18 candidate works after upstream integration; individual running package hashes and detailed coverage were not captured. Reproduction, target-ABI pool accounting and host loader checks pass. Physical timing, complete stack bounds and full qualification remain pending.
gates: All eight reviewed companion subsets build through the actual local session; unchanged standard base output and ZIP/seed integrity checks pass.
Strict 16-byte stock-free scan, both relocation placements and original/current-base guards pass with no direct base-site overlap.
Host C loader install/Undo/removal/memory reclamation and full four-package seed restoration/fallback/refusal/Undo pass; synthetic host glue only.
Exact legacy 0.0.13 and label-only 0.0.17 packages reproduce their original SHA-256; their hardware reports remain separate.
Functional hardware operation reported by Cooper; exact-package physical qualification and full native UI execution remain unverified.
